# Project general coding standards

## Naming Conventions
- Use PascalCase for component names, interfaces, and type aliases
- Use camelCase for variables, functions, and methods
- Prefix private class members with underscore (_)


## Sentence Structure
- All the content will be the English language.
- The content of the article must be checked to ensure that the grammar and word usage are correct.
- When replay the user using chinese, and when apply content to the document must be translated to English.
